description: This file defines the 'Host' class within the 'device' namespace, which implements an interface for device host functionalities such as managing power modes, sleep modes, ports, and related listeners. It contains class declarations, some method implementations (likely inline), and references to various other device-related headers. The file is part of a larger project related to device settings and management.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: A class representing a device host, providing methods for managing power, sleep modes, ports, and other device interfaces. It includes static constants, methods for retrieving and setting device parameters, and listener management functions.
